title: WorkReward - Data API
description: Used to store reward codes tied to a Reward Fund. Reward Funds must have at least one WorkReward record.

Code.description: Represents a singe reward code tied to a RewardFundId.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: Represents the User ID of Owner of WorkReward record

RecipientId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RecipientId.description: Salesforce User ID for User associated with this WorkReward record.

RedemptionDisclaimer.description: The disclaimer information about the WorkReward.

RedemptionInfo.description: The instructions for redeeming the WorkReward.

RedemptionUrl.description: The URL for redeeming the WorkReward.

RewardFundId.description: Salesforce unique ID for WorkRewardFund record that is associated with WorkReward record.

RewardFundTypeId.description: Salesforce unique ID of the WorkRewardFundType associated with the WorkReward.

special_access_rules: You must have the Reward permission enabled in order to use the Rewards feature, including WorkRewardFund and WorkReward.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkRewardHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **WorkRewardOwnerSharingRule**: The original WDC feature is unavailable as of Spring '22. This object isn't available as of API version 54.0. For more information, see Phased WDC (legacy Work.com) Feature Retirement.
- **WorkRewardShare**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
